Text recognition (OCR): tesseract.js and its data, vendored as built
====================================================================

tesseract.js 7.0.0           Apache License 2.0   https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
tesseract.js-core 7.0.0      Apache License 2.0   the Tesseract OCR engine and Leptonica compiled to WebAssembly
                                                  (Tesseract: Apache 2.0, Google and contributors; Leptonica: BSD-2-Clause, Dan Bloomberg)
@tesseract.js-data/eng, deu, fra 1.0.0 (4.0.0_best_int)
                             Apache License 2.0   the "best" LSTM models of tessdata_best, https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best

Files here:
  tesseract.esm.min.js      tesseract.js dist/tesseract.esm.min.js
  worker.min.js             tesseract.js dist/worker.min.js
  core/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js, core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js   tesseract.js-core (the other builds are left out)
  lang/eng|deu|fra.traineddata.gz   the model files

The Apache License 2.0 is in ../LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt. Nothing is changed. Bundled inside tesseract.js's files are
small parts under their own licences (notices below).
